title: bihai rutila
intro: Bihai rutila, commonly known as Red Sandalwood, is a species of tree native to India and Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The health benefits of Bihai rutila include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antioxidant activity, which contributes to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Bihai rutila include santalol, santalene, and other terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
